completed: P0.4 iCloud Mail adapter sub-stage: mail.sync now delegates fetched RFC822 records through ledger-backed mail.sync_records with stable mailbox/UID identities, content fingerprints, idempotent indexing, changed-content reprocessing, checkpoints, and interrupted-claim recovery.

Added synthetic fixture tests for public sync delegation, idempotent re-import, same-UID content changes, interruption recovery, and checkpoint continuation; updated resumable-ingestion documentation and roadmap progress.
decisions: SQLite commits happen before ledger completion; a crash between them is safe because re-import uses INSERT OR REPLACE and the ledger item is resumable.
Provider enumeration/fetching remains inside mail.sync; the fixture-friendly sync_records seam owns only fetched-record indexing and ledger transitions.
No credentials, raw message bodies, or provider data enter the ledger; existing raw mail remains in the existing gitignored local SQLite index.
remaining: Add a provider-native cursor/UIDVALIDITY strategy so iCloud sync can avoid fetching the full UID window while still detecting remote changes safely.
Integrate the ledger into one additional provider-neutral/local import path, such as a document batch or structured text import, with the same interruption and idempotency tests.
Do not mark P0.4 complete until the cross-provider pattern and adapter-level recovery behavior are demonstrated.
